# ScpProximityChat
Also known as ScpChatExtension, ported to work on LabAPI by Kadava for use on Kadava's Calamity.

Known bugs/issues:
- SCP's speaking in prox chat can also be heard in SCP chat at the same time
- SCP's speaking in prox chat may sound robotic or lose mic quality if their connection is poor

**How to use:**
Simply assign which SCP's you want to speak in prox chat through the config!

When a player gets an applicable SCP, they need to press their NoClip keybind to toggle speaking in prox chat.
